thread:
lia: Anyone else seeing KSA projected tokens not expiring after gpu-provisioner restarts? Containers keep getting same token for >2h.
marc: I saw something similar on canary. What env? prod or staging?
lia: Observed on prod-gpu cluster, nodepool 'g-pool-1'. First seen after today's infra deploy (rolling) ~09:12 UTC.
jasmine: Possible TTL projection bug — kubelet projection tokens honor `expirationSeconds`, but TokenRequest TTL can be overridden by webhook or KMS wrapper. Can you grab a token and check exp claim?
lia: grabbed token and decoded: `exp` claim ~ +7d. That's wrong. Should be 1h. pastebin: https://internal.paste/ksa-token-decode-295111
marc: Hmm. Recent change in our token-controller image 1.4.2->1.5.0 included default ttl bump for long-lived tasks; didn't realize it affected projected tokens. @jasmine did we add a flag to token-controller?
jasmine: Yes we added `--default-token-ttl=168h` for SA tokens for some batch jobs. It shouldn't affect TokenRequestProjection but looks like our admission plugin logic copied config to projected tokens. Oops.
lia: :facepalm: That explains KMS envelope wrap leaving tokens long-lived. We need quick mitigation before spike in compromised tokens.
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-045 - KSA token lifetime regression affecting gpu-provisioner. Pager notified.
marc: Mitigation plan: rollback token-controller flag, rotate affected KMS keys for projected tokens (or set revocation), and revoke existing projected tokens: `kubectl delete secret -n kube-system <token-secret>`? Need precise list.
jasmine: Steps I propose:
1) Roll back token-controller image to 1.4.2 (hotfix).
2) Patch admission webhook to enforce `expirationSeconds <= 3600` for projected tokens.
3) Run script to find ServiceAccountToken secrets with annotation `kubernetes.io/service-account.token` created after 2026-03-20T09:00Z and delete.
4) Rotate KMS envelope key version used by token-enc wrapper (docs in ops runbook).
I'll open PR for webhook patch.
lia: I'll scope GPU pools that used the provisioning role and list affected namespaces. marc can you handle rollback?
marc: On it. Starting rollback to 1.4.2 on prod-gpu; will monitor token issuance logs: `kubectl logs deploy/token-controller -n kube-system` and `kubectl get events --field-selector reason=TokenIssued`.
ops-bot: Patch deployment applied to token-controller in prod-gpu. Rollback in progress.
jasmine: After rollback, we should also add unit/e2e test to ensure projected tokens respect max TTL; add to infra CI.
lia: Agreed. Also add alert for projected-token-ttl > 1h in Console dashboards.
marc: :thumbsup: I'll post postmortem once incident resolved. For now, escalate to compliance for audit trail — need list of SA tokens and KMS-wrap logs.
sre-bot: INC-2026-045 status: mitigation started. Assigned: marc, lia, jasmine. ETA 45m.
